# Game Production OS — Synthetic Adapter Project (`synthetic-adapter-project`)

Lifecycle stage `PRE_PRODUCTION` · pinned GPOS `1.0.0-alpha.9`. This is AI-assisted professional game production, not generic software work.

## Authority (highest first)

1. Human Decision
2. Project Locked Authority
3. Approved references
4. Game Production OS (GPOS)
5. Engine and tool defaults
6. Implementation
7. Agent recommendation

A lower level never overrides a higher one. You are the lowest level. This file is a generated projection of levels 2 and 4 and is not authority itself.

## Project authority (`.game/`)

Project rules are separate from generic GPOS rules. Project Locked Authority is a `LOCKED` row backed by a Human Decision; it overrides generic GPOS defaults. `PROPOSED` rows are proposals, not decisions. Read the relevant file before working in its domain; specialist skills list its locked rules and open decisions.

| File | Status | Locked rows | Human decisions required | Undecided |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.game/PROJECT.md` | `PROPOSED` | 2 | 8 | 3 |
| `.game/GAME-DESIGN.md` | `PROPOSED` | 0 | 3 | 10 |
| `.game/ANIMATION.md` | `PROPOSED` | 1 | 1 | 12 |

Not present (no project-specific authority recorded; do not assume one): `.game/PILLARS.md`, `.game/ART-BIBLE.md`, `.game/GAME-FEEL.md`, `.game/CAMERA.md`, `.game/LEVEL-DESIGN.md`, `.game/UI-UX.md`, `.game/AUDIO.md`, `.game/PERFORMANCE.md`, `.game/ENGINEERING.md`, `.game/DECISIONS.md`, `.game/CURRENT.md`.

`HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED`: only a human decides — surface it, prepare options, never fill it. `UNDECIDED`: you may propose a value, marked `PROPOSED`; a proposal is not a decision.

## How work is routed

Start any non-trivial game-production task with the `gpos-game-director` skill (`$gpos-game-director`): it reads project authority, decomposes the task, selects specialists, names the gates and evidence, and plans Human Review. Load a specialist skill only when the task needs that discipline — by its domain intent, not by keyword. Passing tests is not done: each discipline passes or fails its own gate on typed evidence. game-director routes and coordinates; it never implements for specialists, never acts as creative authority and never counts as a discipline-quality cross-reviewer.

Specialists (Codex lists each skill's description automatically and loads the full skill when it is selected):

- the `gpos-game-director` skill (`$gpos-game-director`) — Game Director; gates: none; maturity `DRAFT`
- the `gpos-gameplay-design` skill (`$gpos-gameplay-design`) — Gameplay Design; gates: `GAMEPLAY_DESIGN`; maturity `DRAFT`
- the `gpos-character-animation` skill (`$gpos-character-animation`) — Character Animation; gates: `ANIMATION`; maturity `DRAFT`
- the `gpos-camera-composition` skill (`$gpos-camera-composition`) — Camera / Composition; gates: `CAMERA_COMPOSITION`; maturity `DRAFT`
- the `gpos-qa-performance` skill (`$gpos-qa-performance`) — QA / Performance; gates: `TECHNICAL`, `PERFORMANCE`, `DEVICE`; maturity `DRAFT`
- the `gpos-game-engineering` skill (`$gpos-game-engineering`) — Game Engineering; gates: none; maturity `DRAFT`

Not enabled in this project: `level-design`, `art-direction`, `environment-art`, `technical-art`, `game-feel-vfx`, `ui-ux`, `audio-design`. If a task needs one of these disciplines, stop and ask the human; do not do that discipline's work without its contract.

## Human Review boundaries

Mandatory Human Review triggers (cannot be relaxed): `GOLDEN_CELL_EXIT`, `CANONICAL_CREATIVE_ASSET`, `MAJOR_BASELINE`, `ART_DIRECTION_CHANGE`, `MILESTONE_ACCEPTANCE`, `RELEASE`, `AUTHORITY_CHANGE`. Creative judgement stays with humans. Never make, record or imply a Human Decision, never write HUMAN_EVIDENCE for a human, never lock project authority and never promote skill maturity.

## Machine validation

Agent reasoning is not GPOS validation. GPOS records live in `.game/gpos/`; the production validator is the authority on whether they are valid and whether a routed task is ready.

- After changing records, at workflow boundaries: `python3 -m gpos.validator validate --project .` (exit 0 `VALID`, 1 `INVALID`).
- Before claiming `READY`, merge-ready, release-ready or Golden Cell exited: `python3 -m gpos.validator readiness --project . --routing <task_id>`. Only exit 0 (`READY`) permits the claim; 1 `INVALID`, 2 `NOT_READY`, 3 `INCOMPATIBLE` or tool error.
- Do not run it for trivial edits that touch no records. The `gpos` package must be importable (the GPOS repository on the Python path); if it is not, say so instead of guessing a result.

## Generated files

`AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/gpos-*/` and `.game/gpos-generated/codex/manifest.json` are generated and owned by GPOS. Change their sources instead; edits are reported as drift (`python3 -m gpos.adapters check --project .`) and discarded by regeneration. A human-owned `AGENTS.md` or `AGENTS.override.md` closer to the working directory may add local conventions; it cannot relax GPOS, project authority, Human Review or validation rules.
